highlights: Check for updates goes straight to the newest release from any older version, ordered by version number, and offers prereleases only when includePrereleaseUpdates is turned on in settings.
After Grok Bot updates itself and comes back without Wingman's connection, one prompt gets the Helpers back: press Reconnect, close Grok Bot when asked, and Wingman reopens it with the Helpers.
Wingman never closes Grok Bot itself and starts it only after you close it or press Open Grok Bot; Try again always ends with a plain result instead of waiting.
Wingman finds Grok Bot wherever it is installed, per user or per machine.
An optional setting, off by default, makes Grok Bot's own Start menu shortcut open it ready for Wingman's Helpers.
